headword: {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}

definitions.explanation: A type of fat found in the blood and body tissues, commonly measured in blood tests. High levels are considered a risk factor for cardiovascular disease.

examples.japanese: {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値|あたい}→値：21704_atai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。

⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数値|すうち}→数値：12913_suuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えている→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: At my health checkup, I was told my triglyceride level exceeded the normal range.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{中性|ちゅうせい}→中性：18084_chuusei⟧ (neutral, in a chemical sense) and ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧ (fat). The name reflects that these lipids are chemically neutral, as opposed to fatty acids, which are acidic. {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう} is one of the standard values checked in a Japanese ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧ (health checkup), and the term appears frequently in discussions of diet, exercise, and lifestyle-related diseases. The English medical term is "triglycerides."
